nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/cli, the interactive AI agent CLI with persistent memory. Declares the waggle bin entry point, ESM exports, and runtime dependencies on @waggle/core, @waggle/agent, @waggle/weaver, and the Anthropic SDK.

nodes.name: test-hello.txt
nodes.summary: Minimal smoke-test artifact containing the single string 'Waggle works', used to verify basic CLI output or test harness functionality.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the @waggle/cli package, targeting ES2022 with composite project references to @waggle/core, @waggle/agent, and @waggle/weaver for incremental monorepo builds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses composite mode with project references to enable incremental tsc --build across the monorepo dependency chain (core → agent → weaver → cli).
